mapper.sql: r.id, r.order_no, r.user_id, r.museum_id, m.name AS museum_name, r.exhibition_id, e.name AS exhibition_name, r.slot_id, COALESCE(s.visit_date, r.visit_date) AS visit_date, s.start_time, s.end_time, r.ticket_type_id, CONCAT(t.name, CASE t.audience_type WHEN 'ADULT' THEN ' · 成人票' WHEN 'STUDENT' THEN ' · 学生票' WHEN 'FAMILY' THEN ' · 亲子票' ELSE '' END) AS ticket_type_name, r.visitor_count, r.unit_price, r.total_amount, r.contact_name, r.contact_phone, r.status, p.payment_no, p.status AS payment_status, r.qr_expire_at, r.cancel_time, r.checkin_time, r.created_at

FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN museum m ON m.id = r.museum_id LEFT JOIN exhibition e ON e.id = r.exhibition_id LEFT JOIN visit_slot s ON s.id = r.slot_id LEFT JOIN ticket_type t ON t.id = r.ticket_type_id LEFT JOIN payment_order p ON p.reservation_id = r.id
